title: Critical angle calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute the critical angle for total internal reflection using sin C = 1/n, yielding C = 45°.

title: Refraction at outer surface
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply Snell's law or geometry to find the refraction angle r at the outer surface, obtaining r = 30°.

title: Incidence angle determination
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly determine the angle of incidence i at the outer surface, obtaining i = 45° through Snell's law or geometric reasoning.

title: Final shield radius
description: Essential Criteria: Student must compute the shield radius d = R' sin i = √2R × sin45° = R.

title: Geometry application
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly apply geometric relationships (law of sines, triangle properties) to connect angles and lengths in the hemispherical shell.

title: Total internal reflection condition
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that the condition 'no light exits from inner surface' requires rays to strike inner surface at or above critical angle.

title: Sign or unit errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign errors in Snell's law, incorrect angle relationships, or mixing degrees/radians without conversion.

title: Alternative approach
description: Optional Criteria: Student may use alternative geometric or trigonometric methods to arrive at the same shield radius.
